title: Muraho, {{firstName}}
subtitle: Ibisubizo itsinda rikwitaho ryagusangije
error: Ntitwashoboye kubona ibisubizo byawe. Nta cyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze.
refreshHint: Kurura hasi urebe niba hari ibisubizo bishya

empty.title: Nta bisubizo urasangizwa
empty.body: Nta bisubizo urasangizwa. Itsinda rikwitaho risangiza ibisubizo nyuma yo kubisuzuma.

meaning.title: Icyo bivuze kuri wowe
meaning.followUpAgreed: Itsinda rikwitaho rirashaka kongera kukubona kubera iki gisubizo.
meaning.noAction: Itsinda rikwitaho ryarebye iki gisubizo. Nta rundi ruzinduko rukenewe ubu.

notDiagnosis: Iki gisubizo si isuzuma rya muganga.
askCareTeam: Vugana n'itsinda rikwitaho niba ufite ibibazo.
supportHint: Ifungura Ibindi, aho uburyo bw'ubufasha buri
nextStepsHint: Ifungura intambwe ikurikira itsinda rikwitaho ryemeje kuri iki gisubizo

detail.title: Igisubizo
detail.notFound: Ntitwabonye iki gisubizo. Gishobora kuba kitagusangijwe.
detail.denied: Iki gisubizo ntikiri mu nyandiko wemerewe kureba.

understand.title: Sobanukirwa igisubizo cyanjye
understand.intro: Ibi bisobanura icyo ibipimo bipima. Ntibisobanura igisubizo cyawe bwite.
understand.bpBody: Igipimo cy'umuvuduko w'amaraso gipima imbaraga amaraso asunika inkuta z'imitsi yawe. Cyandikwa mu mibare ibiri, muri milimetero za merikire (mmHg).
understand.glucoseBody: Igipimo cy'isukari mu maraso gipima ingano y'isukari mu maraso yawe igihe cy'igipimo. Cyandikwa muri milimole kuri litiro (mmol/L). Kurya mbere y'igipimo bishobora guhindura umubare, ni yo mpamvu igipimo kigaragaza niba utariye.
understand.clinician: Itsinda rikwitaho ni ryo ryonyine rifata icyemezo ku cyo igisubizo cyawe kivuze kuri wowe.

representative.body: Uri uhagarariye mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko. Ubona gusa ibisubizo byasangijwe bya {{name}}.
